name: website-copilot
description: Repo-wide checks for the website copilot. Each package keeps its own scripts.

scripts.test: npm --prefix copilot-engine test && node --test eval/tests/*.test.ts && node --no-warnings --test demo/live-site/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:py && npm run typecheck && npm run orphans && npm test && npm run test:py && npm run test:speech && npm run test:agent && npm run scenarios && npm run replay
scripts.test:speech: uv run --no-project --with numpy python -m unittest discover -s demo/live-site/speech/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:agent: cd agent && export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$HOME/.cache/acs/deps/agent-venv" && uv run --locked --extra dev pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider && PYTHONPATH=. uv run --locked --extra dev lint-imports --no-cache
